Curated local-model catalog for ItsJustCAD's Model Setup. Entries are LLAMAFILE builds (Justine Tunney / Mozilla): a single self-contained executable that IS the server — no external llama.cpp/llama-server on PATH, cross-platform. The app spawns the downloaded file with `--server --port

--nobrowser` (see local_runtime.rs). VERIFIED against the live HuggingFace repo: URL serves bytes (206 on a ranged GET), size = git-LFS `size`, sha256 = the git-LFS `oid sha256:` from the /raw/main/ pointer. To add/refresh: GET https://huggingface.co//raw/main/ and copy the oid + size. `tier` gates the UI recommendation; `ram_gb_min` gates the Install button. `runtime=llamafile` selects the self-contained spawn path; gguf remains supported in code but is not shipped in the catalog because the app does not bundle a llama-server.
